meta.title: INDEX 350 — W1 Performance Review & W2 Candidate Selection
meta.policy: W2 was explicitly approved by the user without real W1 performance attestation. The 50-page selection is released as source, with no claim that GSC/indexation gates were satisfied.

selectionRules: Only B_SERIES and C_MODEL candidates are eligible in W2.
Candidate parent must already be LIVE before W2 release.
If the parent is one of the 40 W1 URLs and is not indexed, candidate is HOLD.
If the parent is implicated in OWNERSHIP_REVIEW, candidate is HOLD until manual review.
ROUND2_REVIEW_ELIGIBLE is required before final SELECT decisions are emitted.
Final selection is capped at 30 Series + 20 Model pages.
No candidate is published, indexed, added to sitemap or canonicalized by this selection batch.
